description: This file contains extension methods for configuring custom storage log consistency providers within the Orleans silo builder framework. It provides methods to add default and named custom storage providers, and internal service registration logic.

classes.name: CustomStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring custom storage log consistency providers on the ISiloBuilder.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds a default custom storage log consistency provider to the ISiloBuilder. Uses 'null' as primary cluster if not specified.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Adds a named custom storage log consistency provider to the ISiloBuilder. Defaults to name='LogStorage'.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider (internal)
methods.description: Internal method to register the custom storage log consistency provider services into the dependency injection container with specific options and factory setup.
